newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 higher.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 31,900 slaughter steers and 25,700 heifers; 82,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,100 formulated cattle and 100 previously contracted to be shipped this week and 1,500 head or 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 72.00, pen North Plains 73.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 70.00-71.50. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 65.50.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-2 1050-1150 lbs 69.00-71.00.
Wk to date: 82,700 Week Ago: 75,900 Year Ago: 18,900
